Brookfield Acquires Australian Assets, Recapitalizes UK Resort

Brookfield Asset Management has agreed to acquire Australian company Reliance for $2.9 billion. Separately, Brookfield has recapitalized UK resort operator Center Parcs at a valuation of $6 billion. The Australian Financial Review reported that Reliance's backing for a $4.1 billion takeover was its fourth attempt, implying prior unsuccessful bids.
